## Personality

Thomas Lynde is a meek, quiet, and unobtrusive man who lives a low-key life. He is characterized by his slowness and a complete lack of willpower to exert.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P13](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0013), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000)_

## History

Thomas Lynde spent his early life ruled by his mother until he married [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who took over managing him. He remained in the background of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) life while his wife involved herself in local affairs. Upon his death, his widow was invited by [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER I. ## Relationships

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/rachel-lynde--thomas-lynde.md)

Thomas Lynde is married to [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md). While Thomas himself is rarely seen taking an active role in local affairs, [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) is a prominent and outspoken figure in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) who frequently visits neighbors like [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to share gossip, discuss local news, and offer her opinion on household matters.
